comparison_render.scope: Same-input actual native DSP render; no automatic perceptual ranking
notes: Sonic C comparison is not a bit-exact replica of Android Media3 Sonic.
Signalsmith is recommended upstream mainly for moderate time stretch; inspect speech at your chosen rate.
WSOLA is our maintained Chromium-derived BSD fork; it is not a bit-exact browser playback replica.
Listen at equal loudness, including first/last words, consonants, breaths, music, stereo image and rapid speed changes.

independent_boundary_review.scope: Independent focused tail/boundary review with nonstationary stereo PCM and two opposite transport chunk patterns; not listening or Android device acceptance.
checks: exact final stereo source frame when output nonempty

limitations: Host SIMD path is SSE2; Android NEON and full player/output behavior require target validation.
The final-hop boundary blend also applies when Media3 drains a rate-change segment.
